dataItem-mp0pzm8b4.text: Grape Hyacinth Set Dressing

dataItem-mp0qi5fc.text: Due to last quarter, I used PCG to scatter the grape hyacinth, so if put new typology, and PCG will make them have random position, so I manually put the position to match the previous one.

dataItem-mpm7su6e.text: To align with our final deliverable, we need to integrate the AI-stylized output into the texture. I'll integrate the grape hyacinth texture using Itim's AI tool.

dataItem-mpm7syan.text: Grape Hyacinth Development

dataItem-mpm7y42c.text: According to Yiyi's research with Itim, we found a way to make the grape hyacinth texture more stylized. We started with a manually painted texture in Substance Painter, and then Itim ran the texture through her tool. I then reassigned the texture to the grape hyacinth and painted over it to enhance its brushstroke feel. Finally, we got the stylized texture.
